title: Hackathon scout: contact plans (W15f seed, verified on organisers' pages on 17 Oct 2026)
route_ladder_rules: Rank 1: the organiser, or a warm route from a partner who judged the event
Rank 2: the university's innovation or entrepreneurship office
Rank 3: the team's own public project channel (site or contact form the team published)
Rank 4: in person at the next event
Always: an opt-in link to the student idea programme
Never: harvested personal e-mails, GitHub commit addresses, LinkedIn scraping, cold DMs to individuals

project.organiser: Klaipeda Science and Technology Park + Klaipeda University (EU-CONEXUS ENABLES)
project.idea: Captures sediment entering the La Rochelle port basin and collects data to forecast accumulation, reducing dredging

promise_score.note: Illustrative weights (to tune with A'Pelago and Redstone); a ranking aid, not a prediction

gaps.question: Are you continuing BlueSediments after PORTATHON?

Has La Rochelle's port, or another port, shown interest in a pilot?
Who owns the results: the team or the university?
